metadata.status: exact_derivation composed from four exact-derivation theorems (GRLEPS, GPDDT, trapped-constraint derivation, QIEDT); all four backend obligations of the Kerr source backend contract for the spin-half clean Carter chart are closed; the full conjecture remains conditional on the upstream principal symbol trace certificate being promoted from provisional to exact and on the upstream analytic hypotheses (CWCC, CWQP-AB, RRBB, NBCT) being proved
metadata.provenance: Composed as the eighth primitive-packet exact-derivation theorem in the Carter calibrated proof program audit chain. The BCCT cross-checks that the backend contract certificate, the GRLEPS certificate (closing obligations 1 and 4), the GPDDT certificate (closing obligation 2), the trapped-constraint derivation certificate (closing obligation 3), and the QIEDT certificate (the quotient identity) are all accepted and mutually consistent (same chart, same normal form, same q_grav, same derived constraints). The union of the closed obligations covers exactly the four backend obligations, so the remaining_exact_derivation_obligations list is empty. This is a structural composition theorem: it does NOT prove new analytic content, but it composes four existing exact-derivation theorems into a single closed contract.
